welcomeMessageDesc.message: Automatically sends a preset message to a buyer who writes to you for the first time (or again, after the timeout). Runs in the background while the browser is open.

welcomeMessagePlaceholder.message: Hello! Thanks for reaching out, I'll reply shortly.

welcomeMessageVars.message: Variables: {buyername} - buyer's name, {welcome} - time-of-day greeting, {date} - date and time.

welcomeMessageCooldownDesc.message: If the buyer writes again after this time, the message is sent again. 0 - send only once per chat.

featureGatedWelcomeMessage.message: The welcome message is a Pro-tier feature. Get Pro to enable it.

reviewReplyDesc.message: Automatically posts a reply to a buyer's review on your order - a separate text per rating (1-5 stars). Runs in the background while the browser is open.

reviewReplyModalDesc.message: Set a reply for each rating. A reply is sent only when the received rating has text. An empty field means no reply for that rating.

reviewReplyPlaceholder.message: Thank you for your review and rating!

reviewReplyVars.message: Variables: {buyername} - buyer's name, {lotname} - lot name, {orderid} - order number, {stars} - rating, {date} - date and time.

featureGatedReviewReply.message: "Auto-reply to reviews" is a Premium feature. Get Premium to enable it.

aiReviewReplyTitle.message: AI auto-reply to a buyer review

aiReviewReplyDesc.message: Answers a review with text written by AI from the buyer's own words instead of a fixed template. If the AI is unavailable, your template for that rating is sent. Runs in the background while the browser is open.

aiReviewReplyModalDesc.message: The reply is published publicly in your name, so the AI never promises refunds or discounts, never admits fault and never leaves contacts outside FunPay. If a reply fails the check, your template from "Auto-reply to reviews" is sent instead.

aiReviewReplyNotePlaceholder.message: For example: keep it short and informal, no emoji

aiReviewReplyHint.message: Up to 300 characters. Shares the lot-text allowance of 1000 generations per month.

featureGatedAiReviewReply.message: "AI auto-reply to a buyer review" is a Premium feature. Get Premium to enable it.

autoReplyDesc.message: Automatically sends a configured response when a buyer's message exactly matches a command or contains a given word or phrase. Runs in the background while the browser is open.

autoReplyModalDesc.message: Add rules. For each new buyer message, the first matching rule fires. "Exact match" - the message equals the keyword; "Contains" - the keyword occurs in the message.

autoReplyVars.message: Variables: {buyername} - buyer's name, {date} - date and time.

featureGatedAutoReply.message: "Keyword auto-reply" is a Premium feature. Get Premium to enable it.

orderConfirmReplyDesc.message: Automatically sends a set message right after a buyer confirms an order. Runs in the background while the browser is open.

orderConfirmReplyModalDesc.message: The message is sent once per order confirmation. It defaults to "Thank you for your purchase!" and you can change it to anything.

orderConfirmReplyVars.message: Variables: {buyername} - buyer name, {orderid} - order number, {date} - date and time.

featureGatedOrderConfirmReply.message: "Auto-reply after order confirmation" is a Premium feature. Get Premium to enable it.

lotCostPriceDesc.message: Adds a cost-price field with a currency picker on the lot-edit page and shows your net profit. The cost price is also included in the order export. Applies to existing lots.

featureGatedLotCostPrice.message: "Lot cost price" is a Premium feature. Get Premium to enable it.

showFinancesStatsDesc.message: On the balance page (/account/balance) shows statistics over your operations: income, expenses, net flow, a per-type breakdown and a chart.

featureGatedFinanceStats.message: "Finances" (statistics & export) is a Premium feature. Get Premium to enable it.

bulkLotEditDesc.message: Adds a "Select lots" button to your offers page and to your own profile: pick any number of lots and switch them on or off, change their price, or delete them. Inside a section you can also drag lots into a new order, which is applied by recreating the ones that moved.

lotAiGenerateDesc.message: A button on the offer form asks the AI to write the title, description and post-purchase message from your lot data. The result appears in a separate window first, and nothing reaches the lot until you press insert.

lotTransferDesc.message: Adds "Export lots" and "Import lots" buttons to your own profile page. Export saves every lot and currency section to one file, as JSON or Excel; import creates lots from such a file and accepts either format. Existing lots are never changed on import: only new ones are created. The export button appears on other sellers' profiles too, but there it saves only what a buyer can see: descriptions, price and stock, without auto-delivery goods or the after-payment message.
